children: Insider transactions were registered at relatively few but major firms this week, including Oracle
. The following deals took place between September 27 and October 2.
Chief Financial Officer Hong Xu sold 103,046 shares at $13.68 each for around $1.41M. The transaction represented about 8.83% of his holdings, leaving him with 1,064,020 shares.
Executive Vice President Claudine Adamo sold 2,200 shares at $915.93 each for ~$2.02M. The sale accounted for about 23.57% of her direct holdings, leaving her with 7,134 shares.
director Aparna Bawa sold 260 shares at $392.69 each for about $102,098. The transaction represented about 3.95% of her holdings, leaving her with 6,321 shares.
director David Lazzarato sold 22,380 shares at $0.93 each for ~$20,742. The sale accounted for about 10.56% of his direct holdings, leaving him with 189,479 shares.
director Stephen Rusckowski purchased 25,000 shares at $139.35 each for around $3.48M, increasing his holdings to 25,450 shares.
CEO Ryan Cohen purchased 450,000 shares at $23.48 each for about $10.56M, bringing his direct holdings to 40.95M shares.
Several insiders from Simon Property Group
made purchases this week, amounting to a total of $460,716. Directors including Daniel Smith and Larry Glasscock, among others, bought 2,272 shares of the company cumulatively at around $202.78 each.
